focus: We remain focused on operational efficiency, cost optimization and disciplined execution to further strengthen our performance.

We continue to focus on strengthening our manufacturing capabilities and expanding our product portfolio across high energy materials, countermeasures, rocket motors, ammunition and other defense applications.

With a healthy order book -- order backlog and growing opportunities arising from India's continued focus on defense indigenization and self-reliance, we remain confident in the company's long-term growth potential.

about: Premier Explosives Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of industrial explosives and detonators. It also undertakes operation and maintenance (O&M) services of solid propellant plants at the Sriharikota Centre of ISRO and Solid Fuel Complex at Jagdalpur under the umbrella of DRDO. [1]
